assertions.assertion: Uses WebApplicationFactory<Program> with ConfigureTestServices to override IdentityServer registration
assertions.rationale: IdentityServerFactory : WebApplicationFactory<Program> uses builder.ConfigureTestServices and removes the existing IConfigureOptions<IdentityServerOptions> before AddIdentityServer.

assertions.assertion: Sets options.KeyManagement.Enabled = false to avoid disk writes in CI
assertions.rationale: options.KeyManagement.Enabled = false // no key files on disk.

assertions.assertion: Calls AddDeveloperSigningCredential(persistKey: false) for a static test signing key
Registers clients via AddInMemoryClients — no sub-documents needed for this core pattern
